name: Algebra 1 Activities Course Profile
role: Activities change participation around the two approved Practice target plans. Activity Set 1 is a fresh sibling of Practice 1 target plan A; Activity Set 2 is a fresh sibling of Extra Practice target plan B.
question_structure_rule: Use current universal Question Structure and approved Bank family contracts for newly instantiated Activity Set questions.
student_label_rule: Every targeted question shows exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement near the top-left.

source_boundary.bank: approved canonical Bank families for selected I Cans

set1.rule: Same selected I Can/count plan as Practice 1; fresh family instances/values/representations as permitted.

set2.rule: Same selected I Can/count plan as Extra Practice; fresh family instances/values/representations as permitted.

reuse_rule: Stations, Find Someone Who, projected/team structures, and other renders reuse the owning Activity Set questions. Do not author a hidden additional question inventory for each structure.

offline_generation.rule: When the paired target plan and selected family generator metadata are complete, local scripts should assemble the Activity Set deterministically and record family_id + seed/parameters.

retired_requirements: Practice 2 / Practice 3 dashboard quick-view mirrors as curriculum requirements

freshness.paired_parallel_rule: Activity Set 1 intentionally parallels Practice 1 target plan A; Activity Set 2 intentionally parallels Extra Practice target plan B. Exact duplicate finished questions still fail.
